subject: french
general_outcomes: By the end of this level, the learner should be able to;
develop the ability to use the language for purposes of practical communication,
appreciate the culture of other people to promote national and international relationship for peaceful co-existence,
contribute to the cognitive and affective development of the student,
promote positive attitudes and develop an appreciation of the value of language.

substrands.name: Oral Expression Feelings and emotions
learning_outcomes: structure oral communication in a clear and coherent manner
use gestures and facial expressions to enhance oral communication
express enthusiasm to engage in oral communication.
learning_experiences: Listen to audio materials to pick out vocabulary on the different feelings and emotions.
Listen to and repeat sentences related to feelings and emotions. (J’ai faim, J’ai soif, Je suis triste, Je suis heureux/énervé/fatigué, Avoir/être + adjectives)
Play word puzzle games on feelings and emotions.
Engage in miming activities for physical appearance.
Talk about own feelings and emotions.
inquiry_questions: What are the different feelings you experience?
core_competencies: Self-efficacy: This is developed as learners talk about their emotions and feelings
values: Love: learner shows love as they empathize with the feelings and emotions of others
pertinent_issues: Self-awareness: learners express their feelings and emotions.
links_to_other_areas: Link to other learning areas: As the learners engage in oral expression, they can relate it to the skills of clarity, pronunciation and nonverbal communication in English and Kiswahili.

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to respond to questions and prompts in oral interactions
assessment_rubric.exceeds: The learner responds to all questions and goes further to give appropriate illustrations and examples.
assessment_rubric.meets: The learner responds to all questions and prompts to show comprehension and engagement.
assessment_rubric.approaches: The learner responds to most of the questions and prompts to show comprehension and engagement
assessment_rubric.below: The learner responds to very few questions and prompts to show comprehension and engagement

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to employ gestures and facial expressions to enhance oral interactions
assessment_rubric.exceeds: The learner employs appropriate gestures and facial expressions to complement oral expressions and shows sensitivity to diverse cultural contexts.
assessment_rubric.meets: The learner employs appropriate gestures and facial expressions to complement oral expressions.
assessment_rubric.approaches: The learner employs most of the gestures and facial expressions to complement oral expressions.
assessment_rubric.below: The learner employs very few gestures and facial expressions to complement oral expressions.

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to display willingness to participate in oral interactions
assessment_rubric.exceeds: The learner is always willing to participate in meaningful oral interactions with people in their surroundings. Encourages others to engage in oral interactions.
assessment_rubric.meets: The learner is always willing to participate in meaningful oral interactions with people in their surroundings.
assessment_rubric.approaches: The learner is at times hesitant to participate in meaningful oral interactions with people in their surroundings.
assessment_rubric.below: The learner is mostly hesitant to participate in meaningful oral interactions with people in their surroundings.

substrands.name: Active listening Extended Family
learning_outcomes: recall information accurately from oral interactions
interpret verbal cues from audio stimuli
use specific vocabulary and expressions to engage in simple conversations
show enthusiasm to engage in conversations.

participate in language games to improve their scope of vocabulary on extended family.

use the acquired vocabulary and grammatical structures (voici + adjectif possessif + nom. Il / Elle est le / la ... frère / sœur de ...etc) to talk about members of their extended families and others.
Listen to random flash card games and select the appropriate card in class.
inquiry_questions: Why is family important?
core_competencies: • Communication and collaboration: This is developed as the learners listen keenly and actively to each other’s questions and verbal cues while they participate in language games.
values: Values: Unity: This is enhanced as the learners recognize the importance of unified families. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues: Social cohesion: Strengthening family relations as learners learn the importance of extended family members. Link to other learning area The active listening skill acquired can be applied in learning listening skills in English and Kiswahili.

tell where one is going and what is going to do.

inquiry_questions: 1. How do you know where you are going?
2. What do you do when get lost?

values: Values: Integrity: this is developed as learners appreciate the importance of giving the correct information all the time. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues Care of the environment: As the learners learn of the importance of landmarks as they give directions Link to other learning areas: The learners are able to relate the skill of locating and giving right directions to the concept of compass directions in Geography under Social Studies.

fill crosswords and word puzzles with vocabulary of physical features.
fill gaps in simple dialogues using simple vocabulary of activities related to weather. (Quand il fait beau, je fais une randonnée ...
make sentences from jumbled words to practice word order. (Quand il neige, je fais du ski à la montagne)
use picture writing prompts to write about physical features, related weather patterns and activities.
inquiry_questions: What activities do you do to take advantage of different weather conditions?
core_competencies: Critical thinking and problem solving: this is developed as learners think critically when filling crosswords
values: Unity: learners work in groups to fill crosswords and puzzles
pertinent_issues: Pertinent and Contemporary Issues Self-awareness: learners share about the activities they enjoy doing in different weather conditions Link to other learning areas: As the learners associate the vocabulary on physical features to the concept of physical features in Social Studies.

substrands.name: Guided Writing
learning_outcomes: spell common words with correct orthography
create simple sentences using correct structures
appreciate the role of writing in interactive communication contexts.
learning_experiences: fill crosswords and word puzzles with vocabulary on transport. (le chameau, l’âne, la moto, la bicyclette, le vélo, l’auto, le bus, le taxi, le train, le métro, le tramway, la trottinette, le scooter, le bateau, le canoë, le bac/ferry)
rearrange letters to make words on vocabulary of transport and moving around in small groups activities.
make sentences from jumbled words to practice language structures.
write down simple texts on means of transport and getting around common in their locality in group activities.
use picture writing prompts to write simple texts about transport and moving around.
inquiry_questions: How would you describe a trip to a nearby place in writing?
core_competencies: Core competences to be developed Critical thinking and problem solving: this is developed as learners think critically when filling crosswords Values Unity: This is enhanced as teamwork among learners is achieved while working in groups to fill crosswords and puzzles. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues Citizenship: learners share about the common means of transport in their locality Link to other learning areas: Learners are able to relate the vocabulary on means of transport to transport and communication in social studies.
